source.text: Stage III NSCLC (AJCC 7th and 8th edition) patients
Stage III NSCLC (AJCC 7th and 8th edition) patients
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1
Brain metastases must be treated prior to enrolment and demonstrate radiographic stability
Candidate for radiation therapy to at least one lesion
For lung adenocarcinoma patients, patients must not harbor any EGFR sensitizing mutations
Patients who were treated with anti-PD-(L)1 therapy other than durvalumab
Active or prior documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders
Female patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding
